hero.sub: One live build today. I'd rather show one thing in detail than ten things in thumbnail. New cases land here as they ship — yours included, maybe.

stepsSection.label: 02 · How a project goes
stepsSection.sub: Every project follows the same four moves. You always know which one we're in.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: Tell me what you want and what you've tried. I'll tell you whether I can help and roughly what it'll cost.

steps.title: Written scope
steps.body: What gets built, what doesn't, what it costs, when it ships. One page. No surprise line items later.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: I disappear into the work. Every Friday you get a short update and a link to a live preview you can poke at.

steps.title: Launch & stay
steps.body: I keep the lights on. Updates, backups, small edits handled within the week. Retainer or ad-hoc, your call.

footer.bio: Adrian Tajti. A one-person studio in Tilburg. I work with small businesses, mostly Dutch and Belgian, who want a real person to call when something on their site needs changing.
